source_root_contract.closure_rule: The declared closure is exact: all and only source_files are identity-checked. Production C is the exact 16-file M1 set; direct headers/tables support only that set.

rights.provenance: Public tracked upstream file at the pinned Fossil check-in; no Genera media, disk image, PROM, microcode payload, guest memory image, tape payload, or guest filesystem bytes are imported.

exclusions.reason: guest payload and host-file threaded unit are excluded; a later overlay transaction adapter is required.
M1 maps control-store semantics but imports no guest/PROM/microcode bytes.
host transports and guest payloads remain adapters.

import.reason: verbatim, small, public BSD-derived constant/helper may be retained with attribution and byte identity

adapt.reason: reimplement the identified observable semantics behind fixed-width deterministic core state; do not copy host bindings or raw serialization

omit.reason: host threading, wall-clock, files, display, transport, diagnostics, or mutable guest payload is outside the M1 deterministic core

ambiguities: The public checkout asserts, rather than live-verifies, the Fossil revision because its local administrative database is unavailable; byte identities are the verifier authority.

The upstream C keeps backend, thread, and diagnostics intertwined with several device models. M1 records their core-facing state/operation semantics as adapt, but does not claim its host timing or callback ordering.

disk-controller.c and tape-controller.c reference disk-unit.c and tape-drive.c. Those units are explicitly excluded because they own host files/threads and guest payload; later work must define transaction and completion adapters.
uch11.c contains a duplicated recvqueue declaration in the selected upstream bytes; the symbol map intentionally rejects duplicate map entries while preserving this as upstream source evidence.

derived_outputs.nonclaim: Presence or integration status is not a parity claim. Prefix-only functions establish typed fail-closed zero-device behavior, not upstream controller semantics.
